_comment: Generated by tools/data_gen/build_vanity_stalls.py. The `rebut` choice is gated on a flag set by an EARLIER chapter, so answering the fair requires having learned something on the way to it.

start.speaker: The Influence-Seller
start.text: The road does not care who you are. Here, you could be someone. One purchase and the crowd parts for you.
start.text_zh: 路上没有人在乎你是谁。在这里，你可以成为一个人物。买下它，人群就会为你让开。

text_variants.text: The road does not care who you are. Here, you could be someone. One purchase and the crowd parts for you.
text_variants.text_zh: 您已经有了气派，只差一个名分。这个价钱，配得上您。

text_variants.text: The road does not care who you are. Here, you could be someone. One purchase and the crowd parts for you.
text_variants.text_zh: 你的眼太清了，不好做生意。不过——路上没有人在乎你是谁。在这里，你可以成为一个人物。买下它，人群就会为你让开。

choices.text: I was given armour I did not earn. I am not going to buy a name on top of it.
choices.text_zh: 我身上这副军装，不是我挣来的。我不会再在它上面买一个名字。

choices.text: Buy it. Surely one small indulgence won't cost me much.
choices.text_zh: 买下吧。区区一点放纵，想必花不了我多少。

choices.text: No. My peace is not for sale at this fair.
choices.text_zh: 不。我的平安不在这集市上出售。

answered.speaker: The Influence-Seller
answered.text_zh: 贩子看了看你的护心镜，收回了手：「……那是别处的东西。」

bought.speaker: The Influence-Seller
bought.text: A wise purchase! Wear it well... it suits the crowd, if not the road.
bought.text_zh: 明智之选！好好戴着……它配得上人群，纵然配不上这条路。

refused.speaker: The Influence-Seller
refused.text: Suit yourself. The narrow-eyed never could enjoy a good fair.
refused.text_zh: 随你便。眯着眼的人，从来就享受不了一场好集市。
